heading: What is Swagger/OpenAPI and why is it used with a Web API?
content: OpenAPI is a specification for describing a REST API's endpoints, request/response shapes, and auth requirements in a machine-readable document. Swagger (via Swashbuckle in .NET) generates that document from your controllers/DTOs automatically and serves an interactive UI, so consumers can explore and test endpoints without separate written documentation.

heading: How do you document an endpoint's responses and add a summary in Swagger?
content: Use XML doc comments plus the [ProducesResponseType] attribute so Swashbuckle includes them in the generated spec and UI.
